assessmentScope: rtaime software-level ControlHost external gRPC, IntegrationHost OSC/MIDI/GPIO/Companion ingress, production release security evidence. Annex B controls only; Annex A organizational and Annex C SaaS evidence are not asserted.
sourceBinding: Generated by build/security/Test-BroadcastSecurityEvidence.ps1 at the checked-out commit, not stored as a mutable or release-wide PASS in this matrix.

controlRows.finding: Request deadlines are bounded; long-lived client sessions and credential expiration/re-authentication remain unverified.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: ControlHost enforces server-side Observer/Operator roles; OSC and Companion input have no per-human RBAC.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Configured client IDs authenticate devices; individual human accountability is not established.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Internet-facing deployment is outside the supported profile; no public listener is approved. MFA must be designed and qualified before that profile is enabled.
controlRows.remediation: Reassess on any change to internet-facing deployment scope.

controlRows.finding: Authentication, authorization and request decisions are recorded in bounded memory; durable tamper-resistant AAA export and long-term event retention remain unverified.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Control gRPC requires HTTPS/TLS; OSC UDP and Companion HTTP are restricted to loopback. Authenticated encrypted remote adapter transport and deployment qualification remain missing.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Certificate validity and optional client pinning are checked; revocation and automated rollover with deployment evidence are not provided.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Certificate-store/PFX/PEM and environment references exist; production key rotation, backup and HSM lifecycle are not qualified.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Bounded redacted in-process logs exist, but reliable encrypted acknowledged centralized log forwarding and durable retention are absent.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: External listeners default disabled; insecure adapter listeners are bound to loopback. Complete host OS/protocol hardening requires deployment inspection.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Gateway health and ControlHost state are observable; secured centralized security telemetry is not qualified.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Durable state maintenance and backup/restore procedures exist; complete target-environment recovery qualification is not provided by this change.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Qualified management/media network segmentation, VLAN/router enforcement and operational separation are not demonstrated; loopback scope does not substitute for network segmentation.
controlRows.remediation: Define and qualify customer-deployment network segmentation and independent management/media isolation.

controlRows.finding: Online call-home is not required for core local production; controlled jump-host and internet egress policies are deployment responsibilities and unverified.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.

controlRows.finding: Security policy, CI and negative regressions exist; a complete independent secure-SDLC review and deployment penetration test are not evidenced.
controlRows.remediation: Close the stated residual requirement with owner, target deployment and exact-source test/operational evidence.
